## Submission checklist

- [ ] Added exactly one file at `apps/<slug>.json`.
- [ ] `slug` is lowercase + hyphens only, and doesn't collide with anything in `apps/`.
- [ ] `repo` points at a public GitHub repo with a real DSGo app inside.
- [ ] `screenshot` URL is HTTPS and returns 200.
- [ ] `live_url` (if set) points at a real running app on a real WP site.
- [ ] I'm the author or have explicit permission to list this app here.

## App description (briefly, for the maintainer)

What does your app do? Who is it for? Anything we should know during review.
